# EzyGo Travels

> EzyGo Travels is a travel agency in Edavannappara, Kerala, India providing visa assistance, tour packages, ticket booking, certificate attestation and Umrah travel support.

Canonical website: https://ezygotravel.in/
Phone: +91 96563 09061
Office: Ground Floor, Konnar Tower, Calicut Road, Edavannappara, Kerala, India

## Main services
- Tourist visa assistance and document guidance
- Domestic and international tour packages
- Flight, train and bus ticket booking support
- Certificate attestation assistance
- Umrah travel services
- Dummy/temporary flight itinerary support where applicable for visa applications

## Main sections
- Visa services: https://ezygotravel.in/
- Tour packages: https://ezygotravel.in/packages
- Travel services: https://ezygotravel.in/services
- Travel gallery: https://ezygotravel.in/gallery
- XML sitemap: https://ezygotravel.in/sitemap.xml

Individual active visa, package and gallery pages use clean URLs and are listed in the XML sitemap. Information such as visa validity, requirements, availability and package details can change; use the current website content and contact EzyGo Travels for confirmation.
